newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch briefly halt programme trades, options deals.
newsitem.headline: Dutch briefly halt programme trades, options deals.

text.p: The Amsterdam bourse briefly halted options trading and programme trading in shares on Thursday as heavy selling led to a steep fall in share prices.

A bourse spokesman said options trading was suspended from 15.05 to 15.15 GMT and that computer-driven "programme" trades in shares and dealings in "baskets" of the 25 shares which make up the main AEX share index were suspended for the same period.
The blue-chip AEX index has fallen over 70 points in seven sessions since hitting an all-time high of 779.02 on March 11.
It posted one of its biggest single-day losses on Thursday, shedding 24.7 points or 3.36 percent to close at 710.31.

Prices had been lower all day but fell particularly sharply in late trading after U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan hinted he was inching towards raising interest rates, possibly as early as next week.
